decisions.decision: Deliver CraftAssay as an agent skill plus FilePress site plus a tiny TypeScript path catalog. No command-line reviewer.
decisions.rationale: Smell Check, Detangler, Misemphasis, and Cold-eye already prove this shape. The review judgment is host-agent behavior. The spec is the contract. A CLI that called a project-owned model would change the product.
alternatives_considered: CLI that calls a cloud or local LLM
Hosted review web app with accounts

decisions.decision: craftassay-review-spec-v1.1.md is the review contract. Rubric stays v1.0. Site and skill must not invent extra dimensions, scores, or modes.
decisions.rationale: The spec already defines inventory, evidence, seven dimensions, findings, comparison, and the invocation prompt. Implementation should encode that contract, not replace it.
alternatives_considered: Rewrite a shorter product spec and treat v1.1 as background
Add a hosted validator that becomes the source of truth

decisions.decision: Local files only. No PocketBase, no accounts, no project-owned LLM API.
decisions.rationale: Review inputs and reports live on disk. State does not need to outlive the browser as shared product data. Host agent supplies judgment. Matches sibling review skills.
alternatives_considered: PocketBase plus auth for saved reviews
Runtime LLM API for automated scoring

decisions.decision: TypeScript ESM, Node >=20, pnpm. FilePress site shipped with getfilepress and Cloudflare Pages.
decisions.rationale: House language and the sibling site stack. User asked for a FilePress site.

decisions.decision: LocalSlip lease craftassay-site on preferred port 5202. Enroll the repo in the workspace LocalHelm fleet.
decisions.rationale: House local-dev tools. FilePress reads the lease and does not claim on dev. 5202 is unused in the published FilePress lease table. LocalHelm needs a fleet row plus pnpm ship for Sites and Ship.
alternatives_considered: Skip fleet enrollment until after first ship

decisions.decision: Keep CraftAssay and Cold-eye as distinct review questions. One skill handles initial review and comparison when a baseline is supplied.
decisions.rationale: Spec §0 already defines the relationship. A second comparison package would split the contract. Optional Cold-eye pass stays a recommendation, not a dependency.
alternatives_considered: Require Cold-eye before a CraftAssay review

decisions.decision: Canonical public URL is https://craftassay.dev. https://craftassay.com points at the same site. npm craftassay is already staked.
decisions.rationale: Owner holds both domains and the package name. FilePress url and canonical links use .dev so the two hosts stay one product.

decisions.decision: Cloudflare Pages project name is craftassay.
decisions.rationale: Matches the package and the locked brief default.

gotchas.issue: localslip claim failed on Windows when --notes was FilePress site. spawnSync with shell:true splits the value.
